intro: This step in the investigation leads deep into an old crate of Flintridge heirlooms left beside the canals of Stormwind City. Sifting through the dusty relics uncovers a torn journal page, offering a vital handwritten clue to the past life of Stalvan Mistmantle that leads to Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books. Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you got there? I cannot see. My eyesight is very bad. Put it in my hands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely make out those letters. But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
